sourceClosure.omittedSourceGroup: The three fetch-only April-2005 discovery/addressing XML inputs are not part of this service compiler closure. The phase-1 tool and explicit cache remain their resolver.

semantics.compiled: The operation's required request/response/declared-fault/derived-type descriptor graph has no recorded unsupported construct. This is not a runtime or profile conformance result.
semantics.jsonSchema: JSON Schema describes canonical structure, typed references, occurrence counts and representable facets. Explicit nativeConstraints/whole-value checks also require the canonical codec; JSON Schema alone is not a complete XSD validator.
semantics.wildcards: Only native source-declared wildcards/anyType preserve XML nodes. Known lax/strict content is checked against local declarations; unknown strict content is rejected. Open content is not proof of topic payload, vendor extension or transport support.
semantics.topics: Profile-authored topic names and namespace evidence are retained. The locked topicns.xml is a placeholder; complete dynamic TopicSet payload validation is not claimed.
semantics.profiles: Every input requirement retains a per-clause mapping rationale and evidence target. Input-ledger review/recursive-dependency limitations remain below; counts alone do not prove source completeness.
semantics.clients: Client behavior, decoding, workflow and implementation choices are separate manifests, not client-hosted device Actions.
semantics.runtime: The binding-gate and events suites qualify their specific loopback SOAP/security/lifecycle cases. Native media has separate evidence. Compilation never promotes these cases to all-operation, hardware, interoperability or profile support.

runtimeAdapters.actions: Native SOAP 1.2 invocation and explicit accepted-empty one-way policy; operation behavior requires separate evidence.
runtimeAdapters.events: Opt-in pullpoint-v1 Event TM: native Create, serialized Pull, conditional WS-N Renew, and awaited Unsubscribe. Device support, subscription authorization and continuity remain runtime evidence.
runtimeAdapters.metadata: Full canonical MetadataStream mapping, not proof of RTP transport, vendor payload semantics or media decoding.
runtimeAdapters.properties: No generic SOAP Property mapping. Stateful event/search result drains remain native Actions or owned controllers.
runtimeAdapters.security: Declared Digest, UsernameToken and principal-scoped mTLS; no native Basic/nosec fallback. Stock HTTP delegation is a separate per-request path.

semantics.requirementLevel: The local M/C/O obligation, not a flattened effective feature level. Mandatory atoms can have non-null enclosing feature conditions.
semantics.condition: Only null, fact/equals, all, any and not. Evaluate using true/false/unknown. Null means unconditional; absent facts are unknown, never false.
semantics.role: Exactly device or client. Native action mappings on client rows specify consumer use of device actions, not client-hosted interfaces.
semantics.nativeIdentity: serviceNamespace plus portType plus operation identifies a native operation; portType is the local name of the QName in serviceNamespace. typeQName is an expanded named XSD type, never a request element or advertised rule Type value.
semantics.nativeTopic: Expanded namespace in braces on the root topic followed by its native local path. Namespace aliases in payloads/extensions are preserved. The locked topicns.xml is only a placeholder, not proof of a complete topic schema.
semantics.evidenceTargets: Stable names for future assertions/fixtures. Listing an ID is not a fabricated passed test, a probe, or observed product evidence.
semantics.mapping: Native SOAP operations are actions by default, including Get* calls that consume results. Runtime, schema and process obligations cannot be satisfied merely by generating an action/property/event definition.
semantics.alternativeGroups: obligationGroup.atLeastN is nonexclusive and applies to complete branches for this atom's role. any in a condition activates an obligation; it is not an obligation-choice operator.

coverage.coverageClaim: Complete review and row accounting of the selected A/C/D profile PDFs, not recursively complete service/process specifications, implemented runtime support or registered product conformance. Explicit unresolved records must propagate to consumers.

sourceNotes.decision: The prose conditions client pulling on support for profile events; mandatory profile topics already require that support. Preserve the client table M for CreatePullPointSubscription and PullMessages rather than making it optional after a failed or empty event inspection.
Base Notification Interface is not mandatory as a complete interface. This does not erase the separate A device Renew M row on page 16; preserve both pieces of source evidence.

Apply the enclosing conditional-feature section to the client M rows as well as the device rows. Device M* footnotes describe support conditions, not one-of alternatives. Literal function M is retained in sourceRequirementLevel.

Profile D explicitly requires all four AccessPoint inventory operations even at zero capacity. Do not gate GetAccessPoints/GetAccessPointList on the generic WSDL AccessPointManagementSupported annotation.
Profile D explicitly requires all four Door inventory operations even at zero capacity; DoorManagementSupported is a separate configuration-feature condition.

Anonymous decision notifications implied by ExternalAuthorization are required within device access-point support even when anonymous request generation is not supported. Do not apply the narrower Request/Anonymous gate to grant/deny notifications.

editorialDecisions.finding: SetUser is the correct singular native operation. A previous research suggestion to change it to SetUsers was incorrect.
editorialDecisions.decision: Preserve SetUser; do not introduce a SetUsers wire operation.

editorialDecisions.finding: The upload URL contains 2019/12; the cover and revision history identify November 2019.
editorialDecisions.decision: Use documentDate 2019-11 with month precision. Keep the December upload URL unchanged.

editorialDecisions.finding: The cover says June 2021; the revision-history row says June 2020.
editorialDecisions.decision: Select the cover's June 2021 edition and retain the conflicting revision-history evidence.

editorialDecisions.finding: The cover/revision history establish version 1.1, October 2025. Running headers still say 1.0; the November upload directory is not the document month.
editorialDecisions.decision: Select 1.1, October 2025. Do not rewrite the PDF or treat the stale headers as a second source edition.

editorialDecisions.finding: Section 9.2.1 gates device track-description updates on dynamic-track support; section 9.2.3 marks SetTrackConfiguration device M.
editorialDecisions.decision: Preserve mandatory G-device interface availability from 9.2.3 while keeping dynamic-track description-update behavior conditional from 9.2.1. A false DynamicTracks fact does not remove the interface; native invalid/inapplicable requests retain source faults.
editorialDecisions.mappingInstruction: The native source-review issue still lacks named approval. Use the separately declared 0.2-proposed mapping interpretation for deterministic draft assessments only; require named editor and independent domain review before formal release.

editorialDecisions.finding: Printed pagination diverges from physical PDF pages and later repeats. Physical PDF pages 35 and 36 both display printed page 23.
editorialDecisions.decision: Store physical pdfPage and printedPage separately. Use clause plus physical PDF page as the unambiguous locator; never infer physical page from a printed label.

editorialDecisions.finding: Revision-history shorthand does not replace the detailed 1.1 client table.
editorialDecisions.decision: Retain client GetMetadataConfigurations M, GetMetadataConfigurationOptions O, and SetMetadataConfiguration O in section 7.8, within their enclosing feature scope.

editorialDecisions.finding: Some profile paths use VideoAnalyticsStream, which is a type name, not the XML child element name.
editorialDecisions.decision: The native element path is MetadataStream/VideoAnalytics/Frame, with the ONVIF schema namespace on each step.

editorialDecisions.finding: The license-plate-recognition clause includes copied face-recognition wording.
editorialDecisions.decision: Retain the explicit LicensePlateRecognition rule and RuleEngine/Recognition/LicensePlate topic; preserve the contradictory prose locator rather than creating a face-recognition requirement for this clause.

editorialDecisions.finding: PTZ prose permits GetNodes or GetNode while both function-table rows are marked M.
editorialDecisions.decision: For the selected S client PTZ feature, at least one complete GetNodes or GetNode retrieval branch satisfies the proposed mapping; both are permitted. Keep both operations and both table/prose source assertions. Device obligations do not change.
editorialDecisions.mappingInstruction: The native source-review issue still lacks named approval. Use the separately declared 0.2-proposed mapping interpretation for deterministic draft assessments only; require named editor and independent domain review before formal release.

editorialDecisions.decision: Serialize the pinned native PullMessages operation; retain original prose labels in requirement source locators.
Serialize SystemReboot in the Device namespace. This source decision does not authorize discovery or tests to reboot devices.

editorialDecisions.finding: Profile T prose uses GetHostName and SetHostName.
editorialDecisions.decision: Use the case-sensitive native GetHostname and SetHostname names; preserve profile prose as source evidence.
Use PTZ SendAuxiliaryCommand, not an invented operation or the same-local-name Device service operation.

editorialDecisions.finding: The Profile T rule table contains GetSuportedRules.
editorialDecisions.decision: Use the native GetSupportedRules operation without altering the published table.

editorialDecisions.finding: The published topic namespace document explicitly says it is a placeholder.
editorialDecisions.decision: Do not compile it as a complete event-topic registry. Service-specification clauses and supported-topic responses remain separate evidence inputs.

editorialDecisions.previousRule: Public prose names generators, codecs and projector source files as implementation authorities.
editorialDecisions.proposedRule: Pinned native sources own native semantics; original prose and reviewed published catalogs/descriptors own this mapping. Runtime source and SDK documentation are informative, not required implementation dependencies.
editorialDecisions.reason: An independent implementation must not need this repository's runtime to discover normative behavior.
sourceFacts: Frozen catalog contains complete qualified operation and XML descriptor data.
Existing source lock pins ONVIF 26.06 separately from individual schema/profile versions.

editorialDecisions.reason: The missing authority was located in the immutable native service prose, not inferred from an operation name.
sourceFacts: onvif/specs:doc/RecordingControl.xml:1945-1954, clause 5.29.2, explicitly specifies this topic.
Source RecordingJobToken has tt:RecordingJobReference; Data Configuration is an ElementItem described with tt:RecordingJobConfiguration.
IsProperty is false and no Key is declared in that description.
The frozen catalog contains the named RecordingJobConfiguration type but no same-named global element.
Core 9.4.3's general ElementItem type-description rule therefore needs an explicit reviewed machine representation for this native type-bearing case; no global element QName is fabricated.

tests.expected: Both rows resolve exact source/topic/role data; unknown actual payload root is retained/reported rather than synthesized.

sourceFacts: D requires at least one positive capacity and keeps both information interfaces at zero capacity.

Credential identifiers are hexBinary while CredentialToken is opaque.
AuthenticationBehavior is separate, not universally mandated.

sourceFacts: Current operation templates contain native SOAP Forms.

All seven wrappers need examples across camera/recorder/access/adapter scenarios.
